impact_scale.5: Catastrophic (data loss, security breach, system-wide failure)

risk_levels.16-25: Critical risk - Must address before deployment

architectural_risks.description: Risks related to system design, structure, and component interactions

risks.title: Novel graph-based approach unproven for audio transcription
risks.description: Using NetworkX community detection for harmonic analysis is innovative but unproven for audio-to-MIDI transcription. May not achieve target accuracy (>80% single-instrument, >60% polyphonic).
triggers: Community detection fails to separate harmonics from fundamentals
Graph approach too slow for real-time or near-real-time processing
consequences: May need to fall back to traditional DSP approach
Research investment in graph approach could be wasted

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Validate graph approach with small-scale prototypes before full implementation
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Reduces likelihood from 3 to 2 by catching issues early

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Benchmark against traditional DSP approach using same test audio
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Provides data to validate or reject graph approach

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Design architecture to allow swapping graph analysis for traditional DSP if needed
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Reduces impact from 3 to 2 by enabling fallback

risks.title: Three missing components (50% of pipeline) not yet implemented
risks.description: onset_detector, midi_generator, and pipeline_orchestrator are specified but not implemented. Integration risks until all components are built and tested together.
triggers: Interface mismatches between component specifications and actual implementation
Integration issues when connecting new components to existing ones
consequences: Rework required to fix interface mismatches
End-to-end pipeline may not work on first integration attempt

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Detailed component delta specifications already created (900+ lines)
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Reduces likelihood from 4 to 3 by providing clear implementation blueprint

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Implement and test each component independently before integration
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Reduces impact from 2 to 1 by catching issues early

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Create integration tests with mock data before full pipeline testing
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Validates interfaces early, reduces integration risk

technical_risks.description: Risks related to technology choices, dependencies, and implementation

risks.title: Dependency on mido library for MIDI generation
risks.description: MIDI generation depends on mido library. If library has bugs or limitations, could block MIDI output functionality.
triggers: mido library has bug that affects MIDI file generation
mido incompatible with required MIDI features (velocity, timing, polyphony)
consequences: Would need to find alternative MIDI library or write custom MIDI generator

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Research mido library maturity and alternatives before implementation
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Identifies issues before they block development

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Create MIDI generation prototype early to validate mido library capabilities
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Reduces likelihood from 2 to 1 by confirming library works

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Design midi_generator interface to abstract MIDI library (allows swapping if needed)
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Reduces impact from 3 to 2 by enabling fallback

risks.title: Processing time may exceed target (< 3x audio duration)
risks.description: Graph-based approach may be computationally expensive. Risk of processing time exceeding 3x audio duration target, especially for longer files or polyphonic music.
triggers: Community detection algorithm slow on large graphs (>1000 nodes)
Onset detection requires multiple passes over temporal data
Polyphonic music creates very large graphs (many simultaneous frequencies)
consequences: User experience degraded for longer files
Tool unusable for real-time or near-real-time applications
May need optimization or algorithm changes

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Profile performance early with representative audio files (single instrument, polyphonic, long duration)
Implement intensity threshold to limit graph size (filter low-intensity nodes)
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Already in design - reduces graph size significantly

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Use efficient NetworkX algorithms (Louvain is O(n log n))

risks.title: Onset detection accuracy depends on threshold tuning
risks.description: Onset detection uses intensity derivative thresholds. Wrong thresholds could cause false positives (ghost notes) or false negatives (missed notes).
triggers: Default thresholds not suitable for different music styles
Thresholds sensitive to audio quality or loudness normalization
consequences: Transcription accuracy below target (>90% onset detection)
Users need to manually tune thresholds (poor UX)
Different audio files require different settings

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Provide CLI parameters for threshold tuning with good defaults
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Allows users to tune for their specific audio

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Test with diverse audio samples (different instruments, styles, quality levels)
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Finds robust default thresholds that work across music types

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Document threshold tuning guidelines in user documentation

operational_risks.description: Risks related to deployment, monitoring, and operations

risks.title: CLI tool lacks user-friendly error messages
risks.description: If WAV file is incompatible or transcription fails, users may get cryptic Python stack traces instead of helpful error messages.
triggers: WAV file has unsupported sample rate or bit depth
Processing fails due to edge case (e.g., silent audio, extreme polyphony)

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Implement validate_wav_file() function with clear error messages
Wrap all pipeline steps in try-except with user-friendly error messages
mitigation_strategies.effectiveness: Reduces impact from 2 to 1 by providing actionable feedback

mitigation_strategies.strategy: Test with invalid inputs (wrong format, corrupted files, edge cases)

highest_risks: ARCH-002: Three missing components not implemented (score: 8)
recommended_actions: Validate graph-based approach with prototype before full implementation
Implement components incrementally with unit tests for each
Conduct performance profiling early with diverse audio samples
Test onset detection with various music styles to find robust thresholds
Implement comprehensive error handling and validation
overall_risk_assessment.testing_priority: Medium - Focus testing on graph analysis accuracy, onset detection, and integration between components
overall_risk_assessment.deployment_readiness: Architecture is sound but unproven. Requires prototype validation before considering production use.
overall_risk_assessment.confidence_level: Moderate - Architecture is well-designed but untested. Component deltas provide clear implementation path.

performance_testing_focus: Processing time for various file lengths
Graph size with different intensity thresholds

risk_monitoring_plan.escalation_criteria: If any risk moves to HIGH (score ≥ 11) or success metrics not met, reassess architecture approach
